L1_BRANCH.title: Letter to your branch
L1_BRANCH.purpose: Hand this to your bank branch with your evidence pack. It asks the bank to share the police details, keep only the disputed amount on hold, and file your grievance on the official module within 7 days.
requiredFields: the offer to keep the disputed amount on hold
the request to share the police details
the request to file on the grievance module within 7 days, citing clause 10.1(a)
guidance: Write to the branch manager, not the police.
Polite, short sentences, plain English.
Quote the rules exactly, with markers [1], [2].
Never promise an outcome; you are asking, not demanding.
Leave {{Your name}}, {{Your phone}} and the date for the person to fill.

L2_OFFICER.title: Letter to the police officer
L2_OFFICER.purpose: Explain with evidence, offer to keep the disputed amount on hold, and ask for a video-call check and written reasons if refused.
requiredFields: the offer to keep the disputed amount on hold
a request for a video-call check, citing clause 10.1(c)
a request for written reasons if refused, citing clause 10.1(e)
guidance: Write to the officer, not the bank.
Polite, factual, no accusations.
Quote the rules exactly, with markers.
Leave {{Your name}}, {{Your phone}} and the date for the person to fill.

L3_REVIEW.title: Review request to the District Grievance Officer
L3_REVIEW.purpose: Ask for a review within 15 days of the refusal, through the branch, answering each reason the officer gave.
guidance: Answer each refusal reason briefly, with evidence.
Politely ask for the review within 15 days.
Quote the rules exactly, with markers.
Leave {{Your name}}, {{Your phone}} and the date for the person to fill.

L3_DISTRICT.title: Note to the District Grievance Officer
L3_DISTRICT.purpose: The officer stayed silent past 15 days, so the case goes up automatically; this note asks for a decision within 15 days.
requiredFields: a request to decide within 15 days
guidance: State the dates plainly.
Ask for a decision within 15 days.
Quote the rules exactly, with markers.
Leave {{Your name}}, {{Your phone}} and the date for the person to fill.

L4_BACKSTOP.title: 90-day request to your branch
L4_BACKSTOP.purpose: Ninety days passed with no lawful direction, so the account holder asks the bank to remove the hold.
requiredFields: "90 calendar days" passed with no lawful direction
the account holder's request to remove the hold, citing the 90-day paragraph of clause 10.1
guidance: State the dates plainly.
Ask the bank to remove the hold.
Quote the rules exactly, with markers.
Leave {{Your name}}, {{Your phone}} and the date for the person to fill.

L5_LAWYER_NOTES.title: Notes for your lawyer or legal aid
L5_LAWYER_NOTES.to: Notes for your lawyer or free legal aid
L5_LAWYER_NOTES.purpose: A tidy brief for a lawyer or legal aid office. These are notes, never a petition.
requiredFields: the rules and rulings with references
the line "These are notes, not a petition."
guidance: Plain, chronological, factual.
End with the line: These are notes, not a petition.
Quote the rules exactly, with markers.
